description: Hand-labeled queries for retrieval and RAG evaluation. relevant_indices are 0-based rows in clean_products.csv. Natural-language questions are not exact product-name copies. Image paths are relative to the repo root and require local files data/images/product_{index}.jpg. must_refuse means the assistant should not invent the missing product(s). missing_names lists brands/products that are not gold hits.
